title: avena bromoides subsp. australis
intro: Avena bromoides subsp. australis, commonly known as oat grass, is a type of grass belonging to the Avena genus. This plant has been used for its health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, promoting relaxation, and improving sleep quality. The therapeutic actions of oat grass include its sedative, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which have been used to treat anxiety, stress, and digestive issues. The bioactive constituents of oat grass include avenanthramides, a group of compounds with potential anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects.
